snippet.title: The Return to Freddy's 2 Official Trailer (Reupload)
snippet.description:
Finally, a version of this trailer without a annoying watermark.

Original posting date: February 6th, 2015

Original description:

RedEssence5 and I's Website:
http://bfpgames.wix.com/indie

Please Support Sigrid: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCwyPok2vyKIDjpy6ZGLUouQ

The Return To Freddy's Wiki: http://the-return-to-freddys-2.wikia.com/wiki/The_Return_To_Freddy%27s_2_Wiki

I understand the first part seems laggy (It's not laggy, the animation went too fast so I slowed it down) but this is also my first time animating with 3ds Max. :\

You may not collaborate with me on "Official" games (only fan-games). Please DO NOT ask about Skype, for it is personal to me. Also please remember that I do not have a Facebook, Twitter, nor Reddit. But I do have the following:

GameJolt, IndieDB, YouTube, Gmail, Twitch, and Steam.


Tiny bits of people out there are saying this game is full of shit, dumb, etc. And I totally respect that! :) Not every game will have possitive feedback. But when people say that I "stole" content, that is not true. Look at Five Nights at Fuckboys for instants, you have animatronics heads on walking RPG sprites, and during battles you have assets in the background and SFX from FNAF 1 & 2. Five Nights at Treasure Island, you have disney characters on a fan game. FNAF: Fredbear, same thing! My game also has assets. But it's okay! They are all "fan-made games". We make them because we are fans. We put time and effort into our games for gamers out there to enjoy! :) But when people say thieves? No, they don't understand what's infront of them. Also for those who didn't believe me, I just want to point out a friendly reminder that Scott did approve of this, not being the official game, but approved of this game being up on GameJolt (or the internet). Also, I apologize for taking Candy the cat without permission. The first time I saw the character, I was amazed. I wanted to support Emilmacko by putting Candy into the game. When instead I should have asked permission first. I am only 14 after all, and still learning from my past mistakes. I also thought the name Sugar well suited the character. I did not claim it as mine, and should have put a disclaimer GameJolt in the first place. I understand that some of you are worrying about copyright issues, and prevent sues and such. But everything is fine! I have already talked to Scott Cawthon about this time and time again. :) We have talked about this over email, and he did tell me to rename the game before I re-upload, for the game is now called, "The Return to Freddy's".

- BFPFilms424
